name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A pre-built set of senior-engineer habits (spec first, test everything, review before shipping) that AI coding agents follow automatically.
buyer: An engineering manager who wants their team's AI-assisted code to hit a consistent quality bar without writing their own standards doc.
business_use_cases: A startup CTO rolls it out so every engineer's AI agent follows the same spec-plan-build-test-ship process.
A coding bootcamp teaches it as the 'professional workflow' standard for students using AI tools.
A consultancy uses it to guarantee a consistent delivery process across multiple client engagements.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid workshop teaching teams how to adopt and customize the workflow for their stack.
Offer a premium set of additional industry-specific skills (fintech, healthcare) as a subscription add-on.

steal_this: This weekend, build one extra vertical-specific skill (e.g. HIPAA-aware code review) on top of it and sell it as a premium pack to healthcare dev teams.
